gloss: points to reflect on; areas for improvement

definitions.gloss: points for reflection; areas needing improvement
definitions.explanation: Aspects of one's own conduct or a project that should be reconsidered and done better. From {反省|はんせい} (self-reflection) plus {点|てん} (point).

examples.japanese: {今回|こんかい}の{反省点|はんせいてん}を{挙|あ}げる。
examples.english: To list the points for improvement this time.

examples.japanese: {試合|しあい}の{反省点|はんせいてん}を{話|はな}し{合|あ}った。
examples.english: We discussed what to improve from the game.

examples.japanese: {今年|ことし}の{反省点|はんせいてん}を{来年|らいねん}に{生|い}かしたい。
examples.english: I want to apply this year's lessons to next year.

notes:
From {反省|はんせい} (self-reflection) plus {点|てん} (point). Refers to things one did poorly and wants to do better, often raised in meetings or reviews.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {反省点|はんせいてん}を{挙|あ}げる: to list points for improvement
- {反省点|はんせいてん}が{多|おお}い: to have many things to improve
- {反省点|はんせいてん}を{次|つぎ}に{生|い}かす: to apply the lessons next time

USAGE:
Less about blame than about constructive review — closer to 'lessons learned' than 'mistakes'.
